subject: INITIALIZE statement
notes: kb/Work/PB416.md LANDED. The check now runs on the RESOLVED path and takes the resolved DataItem. It was previously wired into the arm taken when the reference does NOT resolve -- an arm a level-66 entry never reaches, because it resolves perfectly well -- so COBOL0835 had never fired for the case it was written for and the violation shipped as an unhandled run-time NotImplementedCobolFeatureException naming a missing COMPILER feature. Taking the resolved item also makes the rule qualification-correct: 'INITIALIZE R66 IN REC-2' names ONE entry, where the former name lookup answered over every same-named candidate. The negative rejects at all four editions with COBOL0835; the positive golden's T5 is the control that a 66 entry BESIDE identifier-1 is not a RENAMES clause in identifier-1's own data description entry and does not engage the rule.
